observation: Today's changes - day-over-day differences in this edition's own observations (no external news). A day with no change is recorded as no_change.
ledger_policy: The ledger (ledger.jsonl) is append-only. A re-run on the same day never deletes earlier rows; it appends a new revision, and the display uses only the latest revision of each day.

kinds.routine: the same series advanced by one observation (folded on the page into one line per day)
kinds.new_series: a series appeared for the first time
kinds.revision: a value for an already-observed date changed (e.g. provisional replaced by final with a different number)
kinds.observation_start: the changes ledger started for this edition
kinds.observation_stop: a series that had values is no longer measured
kinds.no_change: nothing moved since the previous run (also an observation)
kinds.correction: a same-day re-run produced a different set of items; earlier rows are kept
